meta.source: folder widget app/src/main/java/com/yonidev/ydeck/ui/Theme.kt and the icon. Neutrals, type, spacing and radius are shared with YVoice (the Y family); only the accents differ.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Main background of app screens, cards on paper.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Warm page ground: status images (light set), films' day scenes, surfaceContainer in the app.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Chips, incoming chat bubbles, grouped rows (surfaceContainerHigh).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The brand's dark ground in both themes: the logo intro, pain images, the films' brand moments, the Pro page.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: A night block that must stay visible on a dark page (the cover slab, a dark card inside dark UI). Takes ink-on-night and blue-on-night.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the mark on surface, paper and surface-raised. On night always use ink-on-night.

tokens.name: ink-on-night
tokens.usage: Text and the white mark on night.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text (subtitles, captions under headlines) on surface and paper.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted labels, timestamps, the small YVoice signature on night. Not for body copy on surface (3.4:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers (outlineVariant).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and card borders (outline).

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: The one accent on surface and paper: the emphasized word in a headline, links, primary buttons, selected states. On night or the indigo ground use mint.

tokens.name: indigo-fill
tokens.usage: Filled primary buttons with white text.

tokens.name: indigo-ground
tokens.usage: The brand ground in both themes: the icon, the logo sting, launch images, the feature graphic. Takes white text and the mint tile.

tokens.name: indigo-tint
tokens.usage: Indigo wash behind an accent icon or a selected chip.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: The tile that opens. Only on night or indigo-ground: the highlight tile in the mark, the tapped tile, the emphasized headline word on dark. Never on white (contrast 1.4:1), never a full background.

tokens.name: tab-chaos
tokens.usage: Grey browser tabs, wrong-account chips and clutter in pain images. Always ink-3 grey, never coloured.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done states paired with a check icon or the word נכתב.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icons, always with words.

families.display: "Noto Sans Hebrew", "IBM Plex Sans Hebrew", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Hebrew", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: YDeck, written with capital Y and D, tight.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, small stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tiny chips (EN, Pro).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, inputs in settings.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, large cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The island, buttons, chat fields, the mark's voice bars.
